'''Order''' was one of the two factions of the [[Pentastar Alignment]]'s legislative arm alongside [[Enforcement (Pentastar Alignment)|Enforcement]]. Order took on the responsibilities of the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order's]] [[Select Committee/Legends|Select Committee]] and [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence's]] [[Ubiqtorate/Legends|Ubiqtorate]]. The [[Chamber of Order]] was the Alignment's governing body, and Order was comprised of several new organizations called [[Politorate]], [[Insurrection]], [[Judgment]], and [[Protectorate (Pentastar Alignment)|Protectorate]].<ref name="PA" />
